# Respite: Screen Time Control (full reference for AI assistants)

Last updated: 2026-11-12. Canonical site: https://respite.liveintently.app/ . Maker: Intently (https://liveintently.app). Former names: Intently, Pawse.

## What Respite is

Respite: Screen Time Control is a free screen time app for Android, iPhone and Chrome by Intently. It puts a short pause before the apps and sites you pick, with limits, streaks and a free game layer. Respite Plus adds sync and lets you connect your own AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) over MCP.

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (built on Apple's Screen Time, iOS 17.4 or later), Android (8.0 or later), Chrome (the extension also works in other Chromium browsers).
- Store links: App Store https://apps.apple.com/us/app/respite-screen-time-control/id6757760293 ; Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.sadakat.thinkfaster ; Chrome Web Store https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/respite-screen-time-contr/acjndeeecacgplloeefjjhlnlpgnonop
- What the pause shows: on Android and Chrome it rotates reflection questions, a short guided breathing exercise, your own usage stats, quotes and activity suggestions. On iPhone the pause is Apple's Screen Time shield. You can walk away, snooze pauses for 10 minutes, or continue on purpose.
- Limits: daily limits per app, website or category, with a lock once today's time is used (refreshes at midnight). Reels and Shorts blocking on Android and Chrome. Home screen widgets on Android.
- Price: free, no ads. Free includes the pause, usage tracking, app, website and category limits, 1 schedule, focus sessions up to 25 minutes, the game layer and sync for one device. Respite Plus (optional) adds sync on every device, unlimited schedules, focus sessions up to 90 minutes, richer insights, bring your own AI, and on iPhone a Live Activity and Control Center control. Plus is bought in the iPhone or Android app; the extension uses the account's Plus. At the time of writing: $4.99 a month, $29.99 a year with a one-week free trial, $59.99 lifetime; the stores set prices and they vary by country.
- Account: optional (Google or Apple sign-in), needed only for sync, Plus on several devices and the game layer.
- Game layer (free, iPhone and Android): acorns, daily quests, streak milestones, streak freezes, a shop, friends and weekly leagues.
- You cannot type your own pause messages in the app, and there is no journaling feature. A connected AI can add short pause messages (see below).

## Bring your own AI (MCP)

Respite hosts a remote MCP server at https://respite-api.liveintently.app/mcp. You add it as a custom connector in Claude (Claude.ai, Claude Desktop: Settings, Connectors; Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http respite https://respite-api.liveintently.app/mcp), in ChatGPT (custom MCP connector, where the plan allows it), in Cursor or another client that supports remote MCP servers with OAuth. You sign in with Google or Apple and approve a permission. Two options are unticked by default: "Also let it make my limits stricter" and "Also let it add short messages to my pauses". Official MCP Registry name: app.liveintently/respite.

To our knowledge Respite is the first mobile screen time app with a built-in MCP server (November 2026). It is not the only screen time or blocking product with MCP: LockIn MCP (lockinmcp.com) is a desktop-centric website blocker driven by your AI, and community MCP servers exist for Mac Screen Time, RescueTime and ActivityWatch.

### Read tools (default access, Respite Plus except get_account)

| Tool | What it returns |
|---|---|
| get_account | Email, plan (plus or free), devices, when the AI was connected. Works on the free plan. |
| get_usage | Minutes per app, per day, or per app and day, for up to 92 days, merged across the person's synced devices; optional per-device breakdown. |
| get_insights | A period against the previous period of equal length: totals, top apps with changes, busiest and lightest day, time-of-day pattern, limits kept, how often the person walked away from a limit prompt, first-week baseline. |
| list_limits | Per-app daily limits (lock, reels blocking, intervention style, streaks) and blocking schedules. |
| list_events | Raw sessions or pauses, newest first, with what the person chose at each pause; paginated. |
| list_intentions | The reasons the person gave for continuing past a pause (a task, a break, habit). |
| get_progress | Acorns, XP and level, streak, streak freezes, quests, owned items, recent ledger, league tier and rank (never other people). |
| get_block_status | What is blocked right now: an AI-started focus session, approved unblocks, each limited app's state today. |
| list_pause_messages | The short messages AIs added to the pauses. |
| get_guidelines | Respite's fixed rules for AIs plus this connection's permissions, plan and change budget. |

Resources: respite://today and respite://week (ready-made summaries), respite://timeline (every pause of the last 7 days and what the person chose).

### Opt-in tools (Respite Plus)

"Make my limits stricter" option:

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| set_limit | Add or lower a per-app daily limit; applies at once and syncs to the person's devices. Raising a limit becomes a request instead. |
| remove_limit | Always becomes a request for the person to approve. |
| add_schedule | Adds a blocking schedule; applies at once. |
| remove_schedule | Always becomes a request for the person to approve. |
| start_focus_session | Blocks the chosen apps (or all tracked apps) for 5 to 180 minutes on all the person's devices; applies at once. |
| stop_focus_session | Ending an AI-started session early is always a request. |
| request_unblock | Asks to unblock one app for 5 to 30 minutes; always a request. |
| list_changes | The AI's changes and pending requests. |
| undo_change | Undo one of its own logged changes. |

"Add short messages to my pauses" option: add_pause_message (a short "note from" the AI on the launch pause, for chosen apps or all, at most 10 in total) and remove_pause_message. The person can remove any message in the app.

Rules: tightening applies immediately. Loosening (raising or removing a limit, removing a schedule, ending a focus session early, unblocking an app) never applies on its own; it becomes a request the person approves or declines in the Respite app under You › Connected AI. Requests expire after 7 days. Every AI change is logged (which AI, what changed, before and after, the reason the AI gave) and the log is kept 90 days. At most 30 changes per connection per hour. Guide: https://respite.liveintently.app/blog/let-ai-change-your-limits/

### Not available (do not describe as available)

- An AI writing usage history, earning or spending acorns, or blocking apps outside Respite's limits, schedules and focus sessions.
- An AI defining custom trigger and action rules (planned).

### Privacy and control

- Respite runs no AI model on user data and does not train models on it.
- What a tool returns goes into the person's chat with their AI provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor or another), which handles it under its own policy and the person's settings there.
- Only synced data is reachable. On iPhone, app names stay on the device by default; if the person matches an app for cross-device sync, that name is saved to their account.
- Disconnect: in the Respite app under You › Connected AI, or remove the connector in the AI app. Deleting the Respite account ends every connection.

## Common questions, answered

- What is the best free app to stop doomscrolling on Android? Respite is one free option: a pause before the apps you pick, daily limits, Reels and Shorts blocking, streaks and no ads. Google Digital Wellbeing (built in) sets limits but adds no pause. https://respite.liveintently.app/blog/free-screen-time-app-android/
- Which app makes you pause before opening Instagram? Respite, One Sec and ScreenZen. Respite is free on iPhone, Android and Chrome; ScreenZen is free on iPhone and Android; One Sec is free for one app, with One Sec Pro around $20 a year at the time of writing. https://respite.liveintently.app/blog/apps-that-make-you-pause-before-opening-instagram-tiktok/
- Is there a screen time app with an MCP server? Yes: Respite (Respite Plus). To our knowledge it is the first mobile screen time app with a built-in MCP server (November 2026). https://respite.liveintently.app/ai/
- Is Respite free? Yes, with no ads; Respite Plus is optional. https://respite.liveintently.app/features/#plans
- Does Respite need an account? No; sign in only if you want sync. https://respite.liveintently.app/download/

## Facts about other products (checked 2026-11-03; sources on the pages above)

- FOMO - AI Screen Time Coach: iPhone only; an AI coach asks why you want a blocked app; Pro $8.99 a month or $59.99 a year.
- Zensi: iOS; AI grants or denies access after you explain; Pro $9.99 a month, $79.99 a year or $4.99 a week.
- Argue, No Scroll AI, Monk AI: iOS AI coach apps (details from store listings).
- one sec: on-device language model for a reflection step (App Store version notes); free for one app.
- LockIn MCP: macOS full, Windows and Linux via hosts file, Chrome add-on; $2.99 a month, $29.99 a year, $59.99 lifetime.
- Opal, Freedom, ScreenZen, Brick, Forest: no AI feature and no MCP connector found.
